fields.name: OBJECTID
fields.description: {"value":"Unique identifier for each feature in this ArcGIS Online hosted feature service, practical for optimizing queries, not permanent, may change with each refresh.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: REGISTRY_ID
fields.description: {"value":"The identification number assigned by the EPA Facility Registry System to uniquely identify a facility site.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: PRIMARY_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"The public or commercial name of a facility site (i.e., the full name that commonly appears on invoices, signs, or other business documents, or as assigned by the state when the name is ambiguous).","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: LOCATION_ADDRESS
fields.description: {"value":"The address that describes the physical (geographic) location of the front door or main entrance of a facility site, including urban-style street address or rural address.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: CITY_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the city, town, village or other locality, when identifiable, within whose boundaries (the majority of) the facility site is located. This is not always the same as the city used for USPS mail delivery.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: COUNTY_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"The name of the U.S. county or county equivalent in which the facility site is physically located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: FIPS_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"The Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) code identifying the county or county equivalent and the state or state equivalent of the United States where the facility is located.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: STATE_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"The U.S. Postal Service abbreviation that represents the state or state equivalent for the U.S. and Canada.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: POSTAL_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"The combination of the five digit Zone Improvement Plan (ZIP) code and the four digit extension code (if available) that represents the geographic segment that is a subunit of the ZIP Code, assigned by the U.S. Postal Service to a geographic location; or the postal zone specific to the country, other than the U.S., where the facility site is located.","fieldValueType":"locationOrPlaceName"}

fields.name: LATITUDE83
fields.description: {"value":"The measure of the angular distance on a meridian north or south of the equator standardized to NAD83 horizontal datum. ","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: LONGITUDE83
fields.description: {"value":"The measure of the angular distance on a meridian east or west of the prime meridian standardized to NAD83 horizontal datum. ","fieldValueType":"coordinate"}

fields.name: HUC8_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"The 8-digit hydrologic unit code (HUC) that represents a geographic area representing part or all of a surface drainage basin, a combination of drainage basins, or a distinct hydrologic feature.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: ACCURACY_VALUE
fields.description: {"value":"Estimated ccuracy of the geospatial location in meters; smaller values indicate better location accuracy.","fieldValueType":"measurement"}

fields.name: COLLECT_MTH_DESC
fields.description: {"value":"The text that describes the method used to determine the latitude and longitude coordinates for a point on the earth. ","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: REF_POINT_DESC
fields.description: {"value":"Description of the reference point used for the facility's geographic location.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: CREATE_DATE
fields.description: {"value":"A system-generated value that represents the calendar date and time the corresponding information was first posted to the database.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: UPDATE_DATE
fields.description: {"value":"A system-generated value that represents the most recent calendar date and time the corresponding information was updated in the database.","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: LAST_REPORTED_DATE
fields.description: {"value":"The most recent date the corresponding affiliation data was reported to the Source of Data","fieldValueType":"dateAndTime"}

fields.name: FAC_URL
fields.description: {"value":"Web link to the EPA Facility Registry Service page for detailed facility information.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: PGM_SYS_ID
fields.description: {"value":"The identification number, such as the permit number, assigned by an information management system that represents a facility site, waste site, operable unit, or other feature tracked by that Environmental Information System.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: PGM_SYS_ACRNM
fields.description: {"value":"The acronym that represents the name of an information management system for an of the EPA program system associated with the facility.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: INTEREST_TYPE
fields.description: {"value":"The environmental permit or regulatory program that applies to the facility site (e.g., TRI Reporter, NPDES Major, Air Stationary Source Major, Hazardous Waste TSD, Hazardous Waste LQG, Superfund NPL).","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: PROGRAM_URL
fields.description: {"value":"Web link to the general-purpose home page of the EPA environmental program related to the facility.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: PGM_REPORT_URL
fields.description: {"value":"Direct web link to a program-level report about this facility, if available.","fieldValueType":"description"}

fields.name: PUBLIC_IND
fields.description: {"value":"Indicates whether or not the associated data is accessible by the public on the Internet (Yes or No).","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: ACTIVE_STATUS
fields.description: {"value":"The status of the environmental interest at the facility or site (e.g., Active, Inactive, Operating, Proposed for NPL, Deleted from Final NPL, Currently on Final NPL).","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: FEDERAL_AGENCY_NAME
fields.description: {"value":"Name of the federal agency associated with the facility, if applicable.","fieldValueType":"nameOrTitle"}

fields.name: HUC_12
fields.description: {"value":"The 12-digit hydrologic unit code (HUC) that represents a geographic area representing part or all of a surface drainage basin, a combination of drainage basins, or a distinct hydrologic feature.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}

fields.name: FEDERAL_LAND_IND
fields.description: {"value":"Indicates if the facility is located on federal land (Yes or No).","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: FED_FACILITY_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"Code indicating whether or not the facility is the property of the Federal Government. Allowable Values : Y, for Yes, the facility is the property of the Federal Government. N, for No, the facility is not the property of the Federal Government.","fieldValueType":"binary"}

fields.name: EPA_REGION_CODE
fields.description: {"value":"EPA region code representing the regional office responsible for the facility.","fieldValueType":"typeOrCategory"}

fields.name: KEY_FIELD
fields.description: {"value":"Concatenated key field combining program acronym and system ID, uniquely identifying a record.","fieldValueType":"uniqueIdentifier"}
